'''Tinya''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Tinya trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the [[Almas Academy]], a Jedi academy located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. During her [[Time/Legends|time]] there, she served as a tour guide in [[Remembrance Hall]], a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located near the Academy. On one occasion, she was assigned to show the [[Heroes of Cularin]] around the Academy. However, while she was showing them a [[holoplacard]] of the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|Battle of Ossus]], a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] was detonated by terrorists, destroying the holoplacard and injuring Tinya.
